examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a Layout Using Containers and Components as Anchors
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the alignRules API to implement a layout with containers and their internal components as anchors.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting Margins for Child Components
examples.description: This example shows how to set margins for child components in the container.

examples.title: Example 3: Configuring the Container to Adapt Its Size to Content
examples.description: This example shows how to configure the container to adapt its size to content by setting width or height to "auto".

examples.title: Example 4: Applying Vertical Offsets
examples.description: This example uses the bias API to create a vertical offset for a child component between two anchors.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting Guidelines
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set guidelines in a relative layout using the guideLine API, with child components using these guidelines as anchors.

examples.title: Example 6: Implementing Barriers
examples.description: This example shows how to set barriers in a relative layout using the barrier API, with child components using these barriers as anchors.

examples.title: Example 7: Creating Chains
examples.description: This example uses the chainMode API to create horizontal chains, including SPREAD, SPREAD_INSIDE, and PACKED chains, from top to bottom.

examples.title: Example 8: Creating a Chain with Offsets
examples.description: This example combines the chainMode and bias APIs to create a horizontal PACKED chain with offsets.

examples.title: Example 9: Implementing a Mirror Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use LocalizedAlignRuleOptions and LocalizedBarrierDirection for alignment when using barriers as anchors in mirror mode (direction set to Direction.Rtl).

examples.title: Example 10: Setting Component Weights in a Chain
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use chainWeight to set the size weights of components in a chain.
